Embedded VictoriaMetrics components
===================================

lazy-observe release archives and container images embed unmodified upstream
release binaries of the components below and run them as separate child
processes (aggregation, not a derivative work). Pinned versions and archive
checksums live in scripts/download-storage-bins.sh; keep this file and the
license copies in sync when those pins change.

The upstream release archives contain only the binaries, so the license text
is copied from the source repository at the matching tag. None of these
repositories carries a NOTICE file at the pinned tag.

Component        Version    Binaries                     License     Source of LICENSE
VictoriaMetrics  v1.156.0   victoria-metrics-prod,       Apache-2.0  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics/v1.156.0/LICENSE
                            vmagent-prod (vmutils)
VictoriaLogs     v1.53.0    victoria-logs-prod           Apache-2.0  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs/v1.53.0/LICENSE
VictoriaTraces   v0.13.0    victoria-traces-prod         Apache-2.0  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaTraces/v0.13.0/LICENSE

Upstream source code: https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics,
https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs,
https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaTraces
